subtitle: Lesson 5 · The Landscape

code:
-- T-SQL
SELECT TOP (5) ProductName, ListPrice
FROM Production.Product
ORDER BY ListPrice DESC;

-- Oracle SQL
SELECT product_name, list_price
FROM products
ORDER BY list_price DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY;
caption: Same query, same core -- only the "top N" syntax differs.

code:
-- MySQL / PostgreSQL / Snowflake (identical here)
SELECT product_name, list_price
FROM products
ORDER BY list_price DESC
LIMIT 5;
caption: All three happen to share the same LIMIT syntax.

code:
TOP (n)                 -- SQL Server (proprietary)
FETCH FIRST n ROWS ONLY  -- Oracle 12c+ (modern standard)
LIMIT n                  -- MySQL, PostgreSQL, Snowflake
caption: Everything else in the query is identical standard SQL.
